source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole board (board_source.py) + soldout.json verdicts
methodology: Public, past-tense, sold-out-only leaderboard. A window is included only if ranking.is_gone() calls it gone (SOLD OUT) or its listing carried real scarcity language and it closed this past week (FILLED FAST). Fill/close-speed is computed by build_soldout_sweep.build_record (the members sweep's computation) and ranked fastest-first. No guessed sellouts; a missing date is omitted, not invented.
